home.title: Personal
home.intro: Record meetings, lectures and calls. After each recording you get a summary by e-mail, and tasks and decisions are collected here per context. Only you can see it.
home.emptyText: Press Record and choose what it's about, for example a course code or a project. The summary arrives by e-mail about a minute after you finish.
home.recordingsLast: {count, plural, one {# recording} other {# recordings}} · latest {when}
home.openTasks: {count, plural, one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}

context.openEmptyAfter: No open tasks. New ones come from the next recording.
context.openEmptyBefore: Tasks from your recordings end up here.
context.meetingsEmptyText: Press Record. The summary arrives by e-mail and ends up here.
context.deleteText: {count, plural, =0 {The context is deleted.} one {The recording in the context is deleted: notes, transcript, summary and tasks.} other {All # recordings in the context are deleted: notes, transcripts, summaries and tasks.}} This can't be undone. Google Docs you created stay in Drive.

line.pending: The summary is on its way

meeting.pendingTitle: The summary is on its way
meeting.pendingText: It's written about a minute after the recording ends and also arrives by e-mail. Reload the page in a moment.
meeting.noneText: The recording had no speech that could be written down.
meeting.failedText: The recording was saved, but the summary didn't happen. Try again, or delete the recording if you don't need it.
meeting.deleteText: The recording's notes, transcript, summary and tasks are deleted. This can't be undone.
meeting.deleteDocKept: The Google Doc stays in Drive.

tasks.saveFailed: The tick couldn't be saved. Check your connection and try again.

picker.label: What is the recording about?
picker.hint: A course, a project or {fallback}. Tasks and decisions are collected per context.
picker.withDoc: Also write in a Google Doc
picker.withDocText: The notes are then also written live in a new Doc in your Drive. Otherwise they stay in Simon Says.
picker.invalid: Type a name, for example a course code.
picker.failed: It couldn't be saved. Try again.
picker.offline: It couldn't be saved. Check your connection and try again.

live.consentFact: The notes are kept only for you in Personal. After the recording you get a summary by e-mail.
live.silent: The microphone hasn’t heard anything yet. Say something, or test it under Microphone and settings.
live.contextFirst: Choose what the recording is about first.
live.endedFinalizing: The recording lasted {duration}. The notes are getting a final pass. The summary arrives by e-mail in about a minute.
live.endedDone: The recording lasted {duration}. The notes are done. The summary arrives by e-mail in about a minute.
live.leaveLiveText: If you leave the page the laptop stops listening, but the recording doesn't end. You can continue it from Personal.
live.leaveText: The recording doesn't end when you leave the page. You can continue or end it from Personal.

notices.raderad: The recording is deleted: notes, transcript and summary. A Google Doc stays in Drive.
notices.raderat: The context and all its recordings are deleted.
notices.aktiv: A recording is in progress. End it first, then you can delete.
notices.active: The recording is in progress. End it first, then you can delete it.
notices.forbidden: The recording couldn't be deleted. Reload the page and try again.
notices.nytt: The summary is being written again. It arrives by e-mail in about a minute.
